image_description: A side-profile view of a large American Bison standing in a grassy field. The animal features a massive, dark-furred forequarter with a prominent shoulder hump, transitioning to lighter brown, less dense fur on the hindquarters. A single curved horn is clearly visible on the left side of its broad head, which also displays a shaggy beard. The legs are sturdy and dark, partially obscured by tall grass and white foreground debris.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Large broad head with short curved horns.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The head is visibly large and broad relative to the body. One short, curved horn is clearly visible; the other is occluded by perspective but the visible one matches the description.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Beard of long hair on chin and throat.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Distinct long, dark hair hangs from the chin and throat area, matching the 'beard' description.
The eye is visible as a small dark spot amidst the heavy facial fur.
Ears are not prominently sticking out; they appear small and blended into the thick mane/fur of the head.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Massive body with exceptionally tall, heavily built proportions at the withers.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The animal exhibits the characteristic high shoulder hump and massive build typical of bison.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Shaggy dark brown fur covering forequarters forming prominent shoulder hump.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The forequarters are covered in thick, dark, shaggy fur that creates the distinct hump shape.
There is a clear visual transition from the dark, shaggy front to the smoother, lighter brown fur on the rear flank.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Short horns compared to body size.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The visible horn is relatively short and stout compared to the massive scale of the head and body.
The lower legs and feet are completely occluded by the tall green grass and white foreground debris; hooves cannot be verified.
The tail is located at the extreme right edge of the frame and is either cut off or indistinguishable from the background/hindquarters.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The white objects in the immediate foreground (possibly feathers or trash) have slightly soft, undefined edges and lack consistent lighting shadows, appearing somewhat 'painted on' rather than physically present.
Slight inconsistency in depth-of-field blur; the rear of the bison blends into the background with a uniformity that suggests digital smoothing rather than optical lens blur.
